title: Fix emit_main E/nu → Lamé conversion
objective: Fix the bug in emit_main() where params.get('lam', 0.0) returns 0.0 when ProblemIR stores E/nu instead of pre-computed Lamé parameters. Add conversion logic: lam = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu)), mu = E/(2*(1+nu)) when lam/mu are absent.
implementation_steps: Read taichi_printer.py emit_main() function, locate line 810 where params.get('lam', 0.0) is used
Add logic: if 'lam' not in params but 'E' and 'nu' are, compute lam and mu from E/nu
Handle both elastic (SVK) and plastic (J2) parameter sets — J2 stores E/nu plus sigma_y0/K/n
Verify the fix handles all MaterialSpec configurations used in tests
deliverables: packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/codegen/taichi_printer.py — fixed emit_main() with E/nu → Lamé conversion
acceptance_criteria: emit_main() produces correct lam_val and mu_val when ProblemIR has E=200e3, nu=0.3
emit_main() still works when ProblemIR has pre-computed lam/mu directly
Generated __main__ block has non-zero lam_val and mu_val for E/nu inputs
All pre-existing emission tests pass unchanged
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -x -q

cases: Emit with E/nu MaterialSpec → lam_val matches E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu))
Emit with E/nu MaterialSpec → mu_val matches E/(2*(1+nu))
Emit with direct lam/mu params → unchanged behavior

risks: Risk: E/nu may appear under different key names in MaterialSpec.params. Mitigation: check existing ProblemIR fixtures in test files for canonical key names.
